category: A. Sewer Bypass Classified as Normal
operational_implication: Expected & Safe: Supervised XGBoost already handles standard rule-based sewer routing; Isolation Forest is not required to flag every routine sewer case as an anomaly.
Statistical fringe observations (e.g., unusual temperature/salinity ratios) that are non-toxic. Triggers ANOMALY_REVIEW without disruptive sewer bypass diversion.

category: C. Anomalies with High Contamination Indicators
operational_implication: High-risk compound events: statistical isolation confirmed by independent physical hazard cutoffs. Triggers SEWER_BYPASS_OVERRIDE / HIGH_RISK_REVIEW.

category: D. Normal Samples with Severe Contamination
operational_implication: Samples that fall within general density clusters but trigger specific physical cutoffs. Physical rule screening intercepts these directly.
